summary: The notice row states that the title carries gravame, penhora, or indisponibilidade, which can delay transfer and require extra registry work.

risk_title: Buyer takes debt survey and settlement
summary: The edital summary assigns debt survey and payment to the buyer, so condo, IPTU, and related charges need cash reserve.

risk_title: Possession may require extra time and cost
summary: Foreclosure auction closing does not guarantee immediate possession, so eviction or recovery timing can affect the business plan.

risk_title: Credit and own-funds constraints still apply
summary: FGTS and financing depend on prior approval, and at least 5 percent own funds must still be available within the Caixa timetable.
The leiloeiro fee is due on auction day and the non-financed portion is due shortly after homologation, leaving little room for delay.

risk_title: Regularization burden sits with the buyer
summary: The notice row explicitly places regularization on the buyer, so cleanup filings and registry follow-up stay outside the bid price.

risk_title: Exit timing can slip while title issues are pending
summary: An unresolved title annotation can slow refinancing, resale, or immediate exit even if the winning bid closes.

risk_title: Transfer tax may exceed a bid-only estimate
summary: Sao Paulo ITBI uses the greater of transaction value and municipal reference value in most cases, which can lift transfer tax above a bid-only worksheet.
